note: Maps membership joining options (from membership_options.json) to their tier category. Options that span multiple tiers are listed in each relevant tier. 'hybrid_approval_process' is excluded — it is implied when multiple options are combined. 'closed' has no joining options of its own as it represents communities not accepting new members.

tiers.label: Open
tiers.description: Anyone can join with minimal or no gatekeeping. Entry is self-initiated.

tiers.label: Tiered / Probationary
tiers.description: Membership is earned or provisional. Entry involves a process of demonstration, contribution, or supported onboarding before full rights are granted.

tiers.label: Restricted / Approvals
tiers.description: Entry requires approval from existing members or a structured gatekeeping process.

tiers.label: Closed
tiers.description: The community is not accepting new members. If only this is selected, we assume there are no pathways to joining the community.
